pageTitle: 10 Must-Try Veg Kerala Dishes This October
pageDesc: Discover 10 delicious vegetarian Kerala favourites to try this October.
author: Hotel CAPS

slides.title: Appam with Vegetable Stew
slides.text: Soft, lace-edged appams paired with a gently spiced coconut milk vegetable stew make this one of Kerala's most comforting and elegant breakfast favourites.

slides.title: Puttu with Kadala Curry
slides.text: Steamed layers of rice flour and coconut served with rich black chickpea curry create a hearty Kerala classic packed with earthy flavour and comforting texture.

slides.title: Idiyappam with Vegetable Kurma
slides.text: Delicate steamed rice-noodle nests paired with creamy vegetable kurma make for a light, fragrant and beautifully balanced Kerala-style meal.

slides.title: Kerala Porotta with Paneer Butter Masala
slides.text: Flaky, layered Kerala porotta meets rich and creamy paneer butter masala in an indulgent combination that brings together local comfort and restaurant-style flavour.

slides.title: Malabar Vegetable Biriyani
slides.text: Fragrant rice, vegetables, aromatic spices and the distinctive flavours of Malabar come together in a colourful biriyani that feels both festive and deeply satisfying.

slides.title: Kerala Sadhya
slides.text: A traditional vegetarian feast served on a banana leaf, Kerala Sadhya brings together rice, curries, vegetables, pickles, pappadam and payasam in one unforgettable spread.

slides.title: Ada with Aviyal
slides.text: Traditional savoury ada paired with creamy, coconut-rich aviyal creates a wonderfully regional combination with gentle spices, vegetables and distinctly Kerala character.

slides.title: Kappa Cutlet
slides.text: Crisp on the outside and soft within, kappa cutlets turn Kerala's beloved tapioca into a flavourful tea-time snack that pairs perfectly with a fresh chutney or dip.

slides.title: Ilayada
slides.text: A soft rice parcel filled with coconut and jaggery, wrapped in banana leaf and gently steamed, Ilayada is a simple Kerala sweet with beautiful aroma and texture.

slides.title: Palada Payasam
slides.text: Creamy, silky and delicately sweet, Palada Payasam combines soft rice ada with slowly cooked milk for a rich Kerala dessert that needs little else to shine.
